title: Justice Department Files to Intervene and Dismiss Lawsuit that Would Hamper America’s AI Innovation and Security

reading.body:
The record for this incident is itself a failure of the summarisation step. A document was passed to a model in a form it could not read, and the model returned an apology and a request for a different file format instead of a summary. That output was then stored as the incident's summary. This is a system used outside the conditions it was built for, and its output was published without a human check on whether it contained any content at all.

The reporting behind the incident concerns the power supply for an AI data centre. Outlets describe gas turbines at a site in Southaven, Mississippi, said to power xAI's Colossus II Data Center, and allege the project operated without a permit and in violation of the Clean Air Act. One outlet reports that the resulting pollution falls hardest on Black communities. The filings include a notice of intent to sue from Earthjustice and a complaint brought by the NAACP and others against X.AI Corp. and MZX Tech LLC. The Justice Department filed to intervene and to dismiss a lawsuit, describing it as a hamper on American AI innovation and security.

What is not established: a notice of intent to sue is not a finding of violation, a complaint is not a verdict, and the Justice Department's filing is not a dismissal.
